## Academic Citation Generator

Looks up paper details via CrossRef API and formats citations in APA, MLA, and Chicago styles. Results are saved to a Google Sheets bibliography.

**Setup:**
1. Configure Google Sheets credentials
2. POST: `{"title": "paper title", "format": "apa|mla|chicago|all"}`
3. Optionally pass `{"doi": "10.1234/..."}`
